title: run.skill.md has no step to refresh qa_passed in run file after Phase 5 reorder
description: After the a1000121 phase reorder, Phase 6 (Metrics Recording) runs before Phase 5 (End-of-Skill Review). The run file is written in Phase 6 with qa_passed defaulting to false. Phase 5 sets working memory qa_passed = true or false, but no skill step updates the run file after that. All run files produced after a1000121's candidate tag will have qa_passed: false regardless of QA outcome. The event file (Phase 10) captures the correct value via working memory, but the run file is a persistent artifact that downstream tooling may read to determine QA pass/fail status.
proposed_resolution: Add a run file update step immediately after Phase 5 sets working memory qa_passed: call read_file on the run file path, set qa_passed to the working memory value, then call write_file with the updated JSON. This can be appended to the existing 'After all Phase 5 signals are processed' instruction in run.skill.md.
